name: Workcopy
description: Create explicitly scoped, Git-free development lanes and prepare changes for human review.
supportedPlatforms: Windows arm64 (release build; native runtime verification required)
privacy: The plugin starts Workcopy as a local stdio MCP subprocess. Workcopy reads the selected local checkout and stores lanes and review state under the configured Workcopy root. Batch review writes Git objects, including a candidate commit, to the source repository's object database. Preparing a review preserves the checked-out branch and its index. The server does not open a network listener, collect credentials, upload source, run builds, or land a batch.
suggestedPrompts: Check Workcopy availability and MCP connectivity without creating a lane.
Preview an explicitly scoped Workcopy lane for this task.
Inspect a lane and prepare a human review without integrating it.
